title: BA1/670/2005 of SALEEM and 2 ORS Vs STATE

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARANCHAL AT NAINITAL
ORIGINAL JURISDICTION
Dated : Nainital the 18th day of July 2005
Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.670/2005
Order on the bail application of accused
CRIMINAL SIDE
1. Saleem S/o Jameel
2. Kaleem S/o Jameel
3. Naseem S/o Shabbir
 R/o Khushalpur
 P.S. Sahaspur
 District Dehradun ..........Applicants
Versus
State of Uttaranchal ............Opposite Party
Arising out of case crime No.109 of 2005
U/s 3/5/8 Cow Slaughtering Act
P.S. Sahaspur
District Dehradun
________________________________________________________
Hon'ble J. C. S. Rawat, J.
 Heard Smt. Pushpa Joshi learned counsel for the applicants and
learned A.G.A. for the State.
 Perused the record. The learned counsel for the applicant
contended that no independent witnesses have been taken while
making the recovery. The learned counsel for the applicant further
contended that one calf and some meat (flesh of animal) were not
taken into possession by the police at the time of fard recovery.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, it is a fit case for
bail.
 Let the applicant-accused be released on bail on executing a
personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the
satisfaction of the C.J.M. concerned.
Dated 18.07.2005 (J.C.S. Rawat, J.)
LSR
